notes.title: v0.9.0 update is now available
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone[/h2]

‼️ The [b]v0.9.0[/b] version is finally [b]AVAILABLE[/b] ‼️ 

It has been a verrrrry long journey (exactly 3 years since the last update), and I truly appreciate all your enthusiasm after all that time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34829180/a9f736a354edb454663fc4313e258cec7993c37c.png[/img]
[i]Screenshot by Gopensgo291[/i]

[h3]Changelog[/h3]
[list]
[*] New realistic lighting system.
[*] New vehicle (SUV) available at XP level 10.
[*] Improved 3D model of the pickup truck.
[*] New buildings with optimized performance and detailed (and destructible) interiors.
[*] Enhanced physics for tornado-induced destruction.
[*] Visible car body damage caused by hail.
[*] Unknown tornado categories until they cause destruction or data is obtained with a probe.
[*] Wind force affecting trees and grass.
[*] Bonus points for capturing a lightning strike in a photo ⚡ .
[*] Language, time format, and distance format options added to the general settings.
[*] Car mirrors and physics accuracy options added to the graphics settings.
[*] Team selector in Versus mode.
[*] Ragdoll physics for players and animals (🐮 ) caught in a tornado.
[*] Wet textures when it's raining.
[*] Many optimizations for improved performance.
[/list]

And that's all!
It has been a long odyssey, and I hope you enjoy this version that has been so challenging for me to release. 
I hope it will serve as a foundation for improving the map and making many more changes in the future.

Thank you all for your patience 😘 
Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Still working on v0.9... and it's almost done!
notes.content:
Hello Steam!
It's been a looooooong time... I know... and I'm really [b]sorry[/b] ːsteamsadː.

Today I would like to share the new developments made with the v0.9 version which will arrive as a public beta at the end of June.

[list]
    [*][b]FREE ROAMING[/b]
In this video you will see a lot of the new features added to Free Roaming mode in the new version:
[previewyoutube=I-MGGl_7dMU;full][/previewyoutube]

    [*][b]LIGHTING[/b]
As many of you already know the lighting in v0.9 has been totally remade and has continued to improve and over the last few weeks:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34829180/e71305f029367fe27578663731abb5268ec985fb.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34829180/c91e865eff0b71b0b2b352351c5f8756b659c875.png[/img]

    [*][b]TORNADO CATEGORY[/b]
A tornado will not have a known category until it begins to strike objects, trees, cars, or anything that might indicate its category.
This means that an EF5 with an unknown category will give you fewer points than an EF1 with a known category.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34829180/65b4855a9cb23eabaabd35c046a4da60048680f0.png[/img]

    [*][b]DESTRUCTION[/b]
The physics of the destruction caused by tornadoes has changed as well. You can see those changes in these two short videos:
[url=https://streamable.com/olt8w3]Mission 3 in v0.9[/url]
[url=https://streamable.com/2eqy0f]Mission 6 in v0.9[/url]

And remember that hail will also damage car bodies:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34829180/4a6c131abcff5ea369039216bda60aa7b0474d1f.png[/img]

[/list]
And... that's all!
I guess a lot of players aren't playing the game anymore after so long, but it was important for me to come back and release this version with so many changes.
Thank you so much for your patience and see you the last week of June for the public beta!

notes.title: v0.8.0 update is now available
notes.content:
[h3]Aloha storm chasers![/h3]
After several months of hard work and beta testing, the new v0.8.0 update is now live.

[h1]Changelog[/h1]

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] New radar visuals
[*] New cloud's appearance with better supercell formation
[*] Possibility to get flat tires when driving off road
[*] New FM radio mode to read local files (mp3, wav or ogg)
[i](You can change the folder in the settings)[/i]
[*] EAS alerts on the FM radio when a tornado is forming or moving close to a town.
[*] Thunderstorms and Lightning strikes added that can destroy objects or kill players
[/list]

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Pretty big optimization for better performances
[*] New Unity version used for more stability
[*] Turn signals added
[*] Toggle picture saving when looking through the camera
[*] Ability to lock the car doors online to avoid other players to enter into your car
[*] Add footstep sounds
[*] Add stars in the sky during the night
[*] Add some smoke when drifting with cars
[*] Reduce view distance depending on graphics settings
[*] Faster character animations to crouch and jump faster
[*] Hands transparency can be changed in the settings
[*] Possibility to change to the other seat in your car
[*] Tornado siren is now rotating when active
[/list]

[h2]Customization[/h2]
[list]
[*] You can use your own audio files for the EAS warnings and the tornado sirens
[i](Read the file in [GAME_FOLDER]/Mods/Audio)[/i]
[/list]

I really hope that you will have fun with this new version.
Remember to join the Discord server to get the latest news about the development.

Thank you so much for all of your support!

notes.title: Update 0.7 is now live
notes.content:
Hello Storm Chasers!
The new v0.7 update is now live (at last!).

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] [i]Add a laptop in the car.[/i]
You will now be able to upgrade your gears directly from your laptop and navigate through the map on your radar.
This also adds a new feature to be able to upload your photos and probe's data. With this change you will still earn points when you take pictures but no money. To earn cash you will have to upload your photos and probe's data to your laptop.
This upload will last longer if you don't upgrade your bandwidth.
Uploading your photos will also free up space in your camera storage.
It is always better to upgrade your camera storage to avoid having to upload your photos right when you are chasing a tornado.
Here is a short video of the new laptop feature included:
[*] [i]New "Home" interaction in free roaming.[/i]
You will now have a home where you will be able to rest or to sleep. For now it is just a menu without an interior in 3D. If your house is destructed by a tornado, you will have to pay and wait (depending on damage amount) for its reconstruction.
[*] [i]"Feel the power" online versus game mode added.[/i]
In this game mode, you control a tornado and you have to earn more points than the other team (normal storm chasers). You have to destroy things to be able to increase your category. There will be a destruction bar to know how much you have to destroy to gain access to the next category.
You can watch a small peak of this upcoming game mode here
[*] [i]Warn residents of close tornadoes.[/i]
If a tornado is close to a house, you will now be able to knock the door to warn possible residents. It won't give you money, but a good amount of points.
[*] [i]Camera's battery management.[/i]
You will have to take care of your camera's battery level. You will be able to charge it in your car and will have to remember to take your camera with you before getting outside of the car if you leave it charging.
[/list]

[b]Modifications[/b]
[list]
[*] Avoid player from being sucked by a tornado if he is protected behind a wall or similar (and the tornado doesn't destroy that wall ːsteamhappyː)
[*] Optimize map performances
[*] Probes will give you more points (up to 300pts in a EF5 direct hit)
[*] Players will earn less points if they are taking too many similar pictures.
[*] Make the game brighter
[*] Car's lights have now a greater range and lights from street lamps are now wider
[*] Offroad is now more complicated because the terrain is no more flat outside of roads
[*] Better damage sounds when a tornado hits something
[*] More violent physics when a debris is sucked up by a twister
[*] Update max players number in online free roaming private to 8
[*] Increased tornadoes max speed
[*] In free roaming you will now earn XP every 12h instead of every 24h.
[/list]

[b]Bugfixing[/b]
[list]
[*] Tornadoes were not spawning after sometime in online free roaming
[*] Unity version updated to avoid some crashes
[*] Respawning car in Wakota gas station was not working
[*] Changed time of day 00pm and 00am to 12pm and 12am
[*] When player was dying in singleplayer free roaming, he was respawning in his house instead of the gas station (to be able to respawn his car)
[*] Increased the speed needed to be hit by hail when the windshield of your car is broken
[*] If your car was in a forbidden area (in gas stations), respawning it was not changing this state
[*] Changed break light color of the cars
[*] Avoid getting vertical trees rendering when they are uprooted by a tornado
[*] Some female clothes were locked until level 0 was reached
[*] Some debris were flying far away when getting hit by a car
[*] Cars were flying when driving over some big debris
[/list]

And that's all!
Keep in mind that this is a big update that could include some new bugs
Thank you so much for your patience.
Have fun!

notes.title: Version 0.6.4 Hotfix is now available
notes.content:
Hi guys!
Another hotfix update is now available on Steam to fix more bugs.

Changelog 0.6.4:
--- ADJUSTMENTS ---
- Add names to the two small towns (Byrun and Corwan)
- Add a gas station in Wakota and another small one in Byrun

--- BUGFIXING ---
- Clean up data sent in Online Free Roaming to avoid time out disconnections
- In online Free Roaming, A LOT of tornadoes were spawning when another player was disconnected right when you was connected to the server
- Car was not turning well after getting lifted by a tornado
- Radar was making storms bigger when a tornado roped out
- In free roaming, after a long time chasing on the same server, tornadoes were not touching ground anymore
- When dying, the player was stuck without being able to move the camera

I will not be working full time on the game during this month because of the holidays.
I will take advantage of this break to rest my mind and recharge batteries to come back full of ideas and motivation!

Thank you so much for your support and for reporting bugs.
Have fun!

notes.title: Version 0.6.0 is now available

- Music was duplicated when getting an error during loading
- Sometimes there were violent winds without any tornado nearby
- Better auto focus on tornadoes

... And a lot of other small fixes

Thank you so much for your suggestions and bug reports. It is helping me a lot!
Have fun! ːsteamhappyː

- Make tornadoes get weaker before dissipating
- Add Flashlight for your night walks
- Change Hide UI key to F1
- Reduce leaves particles
- Make music volume separated from main volume
- Reduce map border opacity
- BUGFIX: Tornadoes was getting stuck when reaching map border
- BUGFIX: When playing online 2v2 only 3 players were able to connect
- BUGFIX: Sometime there were violent winds without any tornado nearby
- BUGFIX: Player could throw the car in the air by just crouching behind it


I really hope that the next update will be the Online Free Roaming one.
Thank you so much for your support! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Screenshots contest
notes.content:
Hello storm chasers!
The first screenshots contest on Storm Chasers has just began! The goal of this event is to find the best 5 screenshots to add them to the loading screen showing the name of the author.

The rules are simple:
- No photoshop (the creation and modification dates of the file have to be the same - Effects or colors that are not in the game will be spotted easily too)
- The UI must be hidden (F1 key or directly from the gallery)
- Decent resolution (1920x1080 should be enough)
- Only 3 screenshots submitted by player

To submit your screenshots you only have to send an email to stormchasersvideogame@gmail.com with the subject "SCREENSHOTS CONTEST" and attaching your best screenshots (max 3!). 
- Any email with more than 3 pictures attached will not enter the contest.
- Be sure to write, in the email body, the name you want to be visible if one of your screenshot is chosen.

You have 5 days to send your best pictures. After that, I will start a poll to let Storm Chasers players choose the winners.

Good luck and have fun!

notes.title: Version 0.5.1 - Fixes and improvements
notes.content:
Hello,
The game has been live for about 6h and it's already received (a lot of) negative reviews.

Well, I wasn't waiting for this negative tsunami, but I have to stand up and extract of all the possible fixes and improvements that the game needs.
The good thing about Early Access is that the game will never stop to evolve. 

From what I've read in forums and reviews, I think that this could be a good roadmap to start:
Bugs:
- In mission 4, it seems that there is a problem to refuel the car
- In mission 2, there seems to be a problem for completing the 2 objectives for some players
- Mission 5 don't load correctly
- When you activate a probe if you press the button to pause, it freezes
- Radar doesn't show all of the activity areas
- Objective's text don't show properly in some resolutions
- Some game's crashes

Improvements:
- Add Singleplayer Free Roaming (Difficulty: 1/5)
- Add Online Free Roaming [like in GMod] (Difficulty: 4/5)
- Make the game brighter (Difficulty: 1/5)
- Remove the need to complete mission 4 to play online (Difficulty: 1/5)
- Better performance in low-end PC [less particles in clouds] (Difficulty: 2/5)
- Better car physics [better speed up and brake] (Difficulty: 2/5)

I think that those are all of the issues and suggestions that I have found in comments and reviews.
I would like to ask you to not post bad reviews until you are totally sure that the game will not fit your needs and desires, because every negative review is very harmful for the game's future.

More important, I would like to really thank you all for buying the game and playing it.

notes.title: Devlog #3: Road to Early Access
notes.content:
Aloha storm chasers!
After two weeks of silence, I'm back to share the current development state of the game.

I have lost a couple of days of work because of my source code repository (where I save all of my work on the game to avoid any issue in case of computer damage). The size of the game's project is getting very big and I had to find another way to save everything in a safe place.

Beside of this problem, I've also been out another couple of days for personal reasons.

Anyway, those have been the progress made during the last two weeks.

[h1]Money management[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829180/18a78ef178f9232bb2860b0e2d97091ed05dc18a.png[/img]

Inspired by some of your comments, I have added money management to the game.

It is the main feature I've added to the game since the last devlog. It is really a great change and it will change the way you'll play in online game mode.

At game start, all players will have the same cash quantity to spend during the whole game duration.

Currently there is no way to earn money but, maybe, I could add one later.

So... how it works: inside the gas station shop (in the center of the map) you will be able to buy new items and to upgrade other ones.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829180/6800a6067927fdea6b917ddca1bbe821be4ef68d.png[/img]

Of course, you don't have enough money to buy everything so you will have to choose wisely what you need to track tornadoes the best way.
Money will also be used to repair your car and to refuel (both in gas station too).

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829180/a61d47035f509a558790dd9bc6d36ae04ddc433c.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829180/964cd5512d0c576221c0cc94da96bd9d7b7c1c42.png[/img]

It is a big change as there are other players in your team, so you could create strategies to upgrade your radar while another team mate buy two or three probes and another one upgrades his photo storage to be able to take more pictures.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829180/b8b0887a15b8b322ad1d1223fab0d90538f6f924.png[/img]

Of course it is only the beginning and it could become more complex during the Early Access, but I am really exited with this new feature.

[h1]Car behaviour[/h1]

Another small features has been added to the driving experience. 

The car engine will be off at game start or when you are refuelling. 

The car will no longer explode automatically when it takes too much damages (only a powerful hit will made it explode).

When you are near a tornado, wind gusts will influence the steering.

[h1]Some screenshots[/h1]

I haven't done significant changes in the graphical part of the game, but here are two screenshots taken during my last testing.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829180/ab287df77061abe9fe7809c910575bf2f152ec9b.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829180/820cc497dc5070c42c31d5062ffe28c54e548555.png[/img]

-----

That's all for now. 

The game will be launched in june but I don't know the exact day of month.

I will not add any new feature to the game before Early Access launch. I will now focus on bug fixing and closing some legacy tasks that needs to be done before the launch.

Thank you so much for all of your kind words.

Stay tuned for more info!

notes.title: Devlog #2: Pre-Early Access
notes.content:
Hello there!
I'm back for a new devlog about the game. Little more than two weeks have passed since the last one and I have been working on a lot of things. Let's go!

[h1]Supercell formation[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829180/d7451331ac7a0509ec8853a24c132d62de7a2bc3.png[/img]

I think that this will be a sticky section because it will be evolving during the game development to get better results. I have changed the supercell appearance to make it more realistic and it is pretty impressive right now. This "picturesque" screenshot (to quote [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198001916994]Black_Eagle99[/url] ːsteamhappyː) captured during the sunset gives you an idea of the new supercell rendering.

[h1]Wind information[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829180/13d07aba193f9568d88a9334592fb2d648202c73.png[/img]

As [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198156301886]TylerPlaysGTA5[/url] suggests in another thread, the wind is very important in storm chasing and I have added more info inside the car about it to better predict movements of supercells. It becomes less accurate when approaching windy zones but it can be very useful when chasing a faraway tornado.

[h1]Trees damages[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829180/4318bac2f8007b95a153156d3f4b1d912142cc74.png[/img]

In the last version, trees can be damaged by tornadoes. Tree branches are thrown away, leaves are pulled out and even trunks can be torn off by strong tornadoes.

[h1]Car interactions[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829180/c9f5bb08df7098da0002cba417b849c1ef63f3aa.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829180/3df2efaa8efcf385023b2184503004ea39cec9c9.png[/img]

Your car is your best friend in this game. Without a car, you will have to run to chase (escape from?) tornadoes. To add more interest in driving mechanics, beside from fuel management, I have added some new interactions as repairing car damages or pushing the car when it is stuck in mud during high precipitations weather.

[h1]Main menu[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829180/fb02c20678c5d1216a2f2c315737f04af8b61ddc.png[/img]

It is a temporary UI but it will gives you a better idea of what to expect about the game. 
The "Customize" option lets you update your character and car appearance depending on your XP level.
Right now, the free roaming option will not be available for E.A. launch because I use it for testing purposes and it needs to be upgraded.

[h1]Online[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829180/f275631c6ba627407422268368d392066ad9042a.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829180/a5d43e27d9475d05874ebb8841f8cb5966db2f28.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829180/b97fa8b9e84e3486f951a854d5b2b8a329e04397.png[/img]

It has been the main focus of work since the last devlog. I have fixed a lot of things and it is now working as it should. You can't drive other player's cars, but you can sit in passenger seat in cars that belong to your team.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829180/7e0155153e794d8f2164818609774b0ad4a345b3.png[/img]

To make chatting easier with gamepad, I have also added a quick chat  option as in a lot of other online games.

[h1]Launch date[/h1]

There is a lot of work remaining before Early Access launch but I don't think that anything could be blocking the development. There isn't a fixed day, but it will be released during the first two weeks of june.

As I wrote in another thread's comment, the price will be lower than what I said before (it was setted about $15-$20) but I can't say anything more precise as the final price has not been fixed yet.

-----

That's all for now. Don't doubt to tell me what you think about this devlog and if you have any suggestion in comments. It is really great to read that you are waiting for the game to be launched. It is very motivating!

Thank you so much for all of your kind words.

Stay tuned for more info!

notes.title: Devlog #1: The first one
notes.content:
Hi storm chasers!
This is the first devlog about the game after its announcement. I have been working hard for the last weeks and I would like to share with you what have been done. Let's begin.

[h1]Supercell formation and rain shafts[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829180/6089e4304bd0973f0081007030db28ea9342e7a6.png[/img]

The first thing I have been working was to make supercells more realistic and impressive. In the trailer, there was only a tornado with a small cloud above it, but now there are supercell forming and moving on the map that can ending up creating tornadoes.
I have also added rain shafts below supercells when there is heavy rain or hail precipitations.
You can have a better look of those rain shafts in this screenshot of a tornado that touched the ground pretty far away from my position:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829180/8b6cd63d53c076d2e0fa7533d690af83e51c00a4.png[/img]

[h1]Better GPS radar[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829180/347b81a0dbbf233f4ec9af994883829f76fa29e8.png[/img]

There are also a lot of changes in the GPS radar. The supercell's formation are now appearing more realistically and I have added more useful information about roads, buildings, points of interest... etc. Of course it is far to be perfect but I think that I will let it unchanged for the early access launch.

[h1]Rain on windows and winshield  wipers[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829180/a84faf6042952490cfdaac8dbb215b7a48f03adf.png[/img]

Another graphical point that I was wishing to modify was the rain visual effects inside the car. I think that it is very important that the player feels safe and protected inside his vehicle and, for me, the windshield wipers are one element that can gives you this feeling.
It is really great to watch heavy rain falling on the window and listen the wipers cleaning the windshield. Of course, you can't expect a realistic effect like in the Drive Club game but I think it is enough... for the moment ;-).

As you can see in the screenshot above, I have also changed the hands of the driver to match the skin tone that you have selected for your avatar and I have added more info icons (car lights, engine gears... etc.)

[h1]Fill up the gas tank[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34829180/e33ab08e4618b207c16a10b64ef7e09430d730f1.png[/img]

It was something that was already working in the past version of the game, but, to add more realistic interactions, I have added the need to exit your car to fill up the gas tank and not only to have to drive to the gas station and to wait inside the car.

[h1]Online[/h1]

Those was the changes made on the visual part of the game but the main work I have done in the past weeks has been in the online mode. I have fixed a lot of gameplay mechanics and I need to also add more features as "Invite your friends" and "Inactivity disconnection" for example.

That's all for now. Thank you very much for your interest about the game. I will try to respond every question that you could have about it, as I have done for now.

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Preparing Early Access
notes.content:
Here we are... The Steam page of the game is now live and I have to work even harder to get everything done before the Early Access launch.

I would like to share with you an early development roadmap in the short term:

[h1]Early Access launch features[/h1]
[list]
[*] 8 Singleplayer missions
[*] 1 Online multiplayer game mode available in 1 vs 1, 2 vs 2 and 4 vs 4
[*] Customizable character and car
[*] Editable online FM radio stations
[/list]

[h1]Early Access post-launch features[/h1]
[list]
[*] 2 New online multiplayer game modes
[*] New gameplay interactions
[*] More character and car customization
[*] Local MP3 as an FM radio station
[/list]

Don't forget to share your suggestions and ideas in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/862800/discussions/0/]Suggestions / Ideas[/url] board.

This roadmap could dramatically change in the next weeks/months but it will gives you and idea of what to expect from Storm Chasers.

Thank you so much for your support.
